label: VI-Rig 4 IMUs + 4 cams
title: VI-Rig: 4 IMUs + 4 cameras
intro: Our rig with a RealSense T265 fisheye pair (global shutter) and an ELP stereo pair (rolling shutter).

image.alt: MVIS solving a VI-Rig 4-camera recording: board, camera path and one T265 fisheye frame
image.credit: MVIS solve view, from the homepage

families.title: t265 GS fisheye stereo
families.read_first: MVIS estimates the board shape; Kalibr assumes a flat board.
notes: Bag 09: fisheye 2 starts one frame before fisheye 1. Kalibr ran on a copy with that frame dropped, because its 4 Hz sampling of each camera otherwise pairs frames one apart and it diverges.
Basalt groups stereo frames by stamp and the t265 pair never shares one, so its fisheye 2 frames are snapped onto fisheye 1's (1.8–5 ms apart).

families.title: ELP RS stereo + readout
families.read_first: Lens models differ, so only readout has a difference, and Kalibr wasn't re-run after the ELP stamp correction. Basalt is shown only.
notes: Kalibr has 13 of 15 recordings on ELP-R. MVIS uses an equidistant lens model, Kalibr and Basalt radtan, so fx, fy, cx, cy and distortion have no difference, and the dist[2] and dist[3] rows hold different coefficients per tool. Basalt solves this rolling-shutter pair as global shutter. Kalibr wasn't re-run after the ELP stamp correction; we expect it to be unchanged, but that wasn't tested. MVIS estimates the board shape; Kalibr assumes a flat board.

Kalibr's rolling-shutter model calibrates one camera at a time, so it has no ELP stereo baseline. ELP-R bags 8 and 13 failed (autodiff overflow at bag-freq 15; the bag-freq-10 retry overflowed again on bag 8 and converged to a non-physical basin on bag 13) and are excluded.

Basalt has no rolling-shutter model: it solves the ELP pair as global shutter with pinhole-radtan8 (seeded from kb4), so its T2 values are shown only. Since 2026-11-01 MVIS solves the ELP with the equidistant model while the Kalibr RS runs are radtan: readout is compared; fx, fy, cx, cy and distortion are shown without a difference because the lens models differ.

families.title: Mixed t265-f1 + ELP-L, aux Xsens

solved.reason: not run: one IMU per run and no rolling-shutter model; no run holds the whole rig

families.read_first: Kalibr treats ELP-L as global shutter; its intrinsics and baselines are inputs from an MVIS export. Data settings differ between the tools.
notes: Basalt cannot calibrate T7 — no rolling-shutter model for ELP-L, one IMU per run, and one time offset shared by all cameras (the t265 and ELP clocks share no frame stamps).

Kalibr has 14 of 15 recordings (bag 8 failed). Its ELP-L readout is fixed at 0, and ELP-L's stamps were shifted by the MVIS td of the same bag before each Kalibr run. Its td and lever are solved given these inputs. MVIS uses two corners per tag, non-base cameras at 4 Hz or lower and an estimated board shape; Kalibr has none of these.

MVIS solves t265 fisheye 1 (GS) + ELP-L (rolling shutter, readout estimated) + both IMUs. Kalibr's camera + IMU solver is global-shutter only, so its runs take ELP-L as a GS camera and its readout tr is reported as 0 (its global-shutter model, not an estimate). Kalibr bag 8 is excluded: its base gyro scales (1.23 / 2.23) are far from the other 14 bags (about 1.01), a failed solve; MVIS keeps bag 8, so its n is 15 and Kalibr's is 14.

families.title: ELP RS stereo + two IMUs (IMUs only)
families.read_first: Kalibr has 3 of 15 recordings, IMUs only, from earlier runs with an MVIS export as camera input. Data settings differ between the tools.
notes: Kalibr's values come from separate earlier runs of bags 1–3 with t265 fisheye 1 only, so MVIS − Kalibr compares 15 recordings with 3. MVIS uses two corners per tag, non-base cameras at 4 Hz or lower and an estimated board shape; Kalibr has none of these.

No RS-anchored Kalibr run exists: Kalibr's camera + IMU solver cannot use the ELP rolling-shutter cameras. T8's IMUs (t265 base, Xsens aux) are the same physical IMUs on the same bags as T7, so they are compared with separate earlier Kalibr runs of bags 1–3 (t265 fisheye 1 only), not the T7 runs. Its ELP cameras have no Kalibr counterpart and are listed with MVIS values only.
